A '''battle''' at [[Drearia/Legends|Drearia]] was a engagement during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] liberation campaign after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. The New Republic sent a fleet from [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]], liberated [[4 ABY/Legends|two years ago]], to the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] in order to access the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" />
